assertions.name: h4_coefficient_of_tr_M_equals_minus_three_quarters
assertions.source: Borromean Markov trace tr_M(β_Bor) = (4 + h² − 3h⁴ − h⁶) / (h² + 4) Taylor-expands to 1 + 0·h² − (3/4)·h⁴ − (1/16)·h⁶ + ...  The h⁴ coefficient extracted numerically from the closed form equals exactly −3/4.

assertions.name: wenzl_weight_y_2_1_at_q_one_equals_quarter
assertions.source: From the Frobenius expansion: h⁴-coeff(tr_M) = −3·y_{(2,1)}(0) since χ^{(2,1)}(β_Bor) at h⁴ is −3 (per T15) and the (3), (1³) contributions have no h⁴ correction (χ^{(3)}=χ^{(1³)}=1 exactly).  Solving −3·y_{(2,1)}(0) = −3/4 gives y_{(2,1)}(0) = 1/4.

assertions.name: wenzl_weight_equals_inverse_q_2_squared_at_q_one
assertions.source: 1/[2]_q²|_{q=1} = 1/(q + q⁻¹)²|_{q=1} = 1/4 = Markov normalization factor for 3-component link closure. The (h² + 4) denominator in tr_M(β_Bor) IS [2]_q² in h-coordinates.

assertions.name: closed_form_wenzl_markov_sum_equals_one
assertions.source: Σ_λ y_λ(1)·d_λ = tr_M(1_3) = 1 (Markov normalization for the identity braid) with the CLOSED-FORM weight vector (y_(3), y_(2,1), y_(1³))|_{q=1} = (1/2, 1/4, 0) and d_λ = (1, 2, 1): 1·(1/2) + 2·(1/4) + 1·0 = 1. CORRECTED from the original uniform (1/4,1/4,1/4) claim — the Jones trace is chiral; see prop:h3-markov-wenzl-weights.

assertions.name: borromean_reproduction_from_closed_form_weights
assertions.source: The closed-form weights y_(3) = [4]_q/[2]_q³, y_(2,1) = 1/[2]_q², y_(1³) = 0 reproduce tr_M(β_Bor) = (4 + h² − 3h⁴ − h⁶)/(h² + 4) exactly at sample q = 1.3 (independent verification of prop:h3-markov-wenzl-weights).

description: GAP-A-4 T18 — Markov-trace normalization closes the categorical chain. Derives y_{(2,1)}(q=1) = 1/4 = 1/[2]_q²|_{q=1} from the Frobenius expansion + closed-form h⁴ = −3/4 + T15 polynomial χ^{(2,1)} = 2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶. Identifies 1/4 as the Markov normalization factor for 3-component Borromean link closure. Combined with T17 R-matrix derivation of χ^{(2,1)}, the Borromean h⁴ = −3/4 = (−3)·(1/4) is now derived from first principles within H_3.

wenzl_weights_at_q_one.correction_note: Original T18d claimed uniform weights (1/4, 1/4, 1/4) via bar-involution; WRONG — Jones trace is chiral. Corrected to (1/2, 1/4, 0) per prop:h3-markov-wenzl-weights. Caught by review on PR #2191.

data.synthesis_verdict: T18 CLOSES THE CATEGORICAL CHAIN within H_3 for the Borromean h⁴ = −3/4: combining T17's R-matrix derivation of χ^{(2,1)}(β_Bor) = 2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶ with T18's Markov-normalization derivation of y_{(2,1)}(q=1) = 1/4 = 1/[2]_q²|_{q=1} gives h⁴(tr_M) = (−3) · (1/4) = −3/4 from first principles.  The factor 1/4 is structurally the Markov-trace normalization for c=3-component link closure: tr_M = V_{Jones} / [2]_q^{c−1}, and (h² + 4) = [2]_q² is exactly the denominator in the closed form tr_M(β_Bor) = (4 + h² − 3h⁴ − h⁶) / (h² + 4).  All five assertions pass.  IMPORTANT SCOPE: this closes the WITHIN-H_3 categorical chain (3-strand side of the Borromean story); it does NOT resolve the CROSS-ALGEBRA h⁴ obstruction linking 5-strand A_5 fiber action to 3-strand H_3 — that was the original GAP-A-4 question and remains open per the T4-T14 retrospective.
